CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  September 16, 2024

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Dorado, Gardea, Juarez, Mojarro, Pham, Tsujii, Olson

  Absent:  Grijalva, Ho, Garcia

  Commissioner Grijalva arrived at 7:01 P.M.
  Vice President Garcia arrived at 7:02 P.M.

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Maia McCurley, Principal Planner;
  Yalini Siva, Senior Planner; Karabeth Garcia, Executive Assistant; Erica
  Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – AUGUST, 5, 2024 (7:01 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the August 5, 2024, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the August 5, 2024, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner Pham.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-1-1
  Ayes:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Juarez, Mojarro, Pham, Tsujii,
  Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: Garcia
  Absent:  Ho

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video
  recordings of the discussion is available here:

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion Items.

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-23-27 (7:02 P.M.)
  • 1825 & 1827 Cedar Street
  • Applicant: Samira Squires of Kimberlina Whettam &
  Associates
  • Request: Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-27 is a request to
  permit an existing Recovery Bridge Housing (RBH) facility, a type
  of Group Residential use, that has been in operation at 1825 &
  1827 Cedar Street in the RH (Residential High Density) zone
  since 2019.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 24-16 approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-27 permitting an existing
  Recovery Bridge Housing (RBH) facility, a type of Group
  Residential use, subject to the Conditions of Approval, and finding
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-27 permitting an existing
  Recovery Bridge Housing (RBH) facility to be exempt from review
  under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant
  to Section 15301, Class 1 of Title 14 of the California Code of
  Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects that are
  existing facilities.
  • Senior Planner Yalini Siva provided the Staff presentation.
  • Samira Squires, the Applicant, provided the Applicant
  presentation and was available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 2.
  •  Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner Tsujii.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Juarez, Mojarro, Pham, Tsujii,
  Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Ho

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video

G.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

H.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING
  REPORTS:

  •  There were no Comments or Conference/Meeting Reports from the Planning
  Commission.

I.  COMMENTS FROM STAFF:

  •  Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso commented on the approval of the Housing
  Element and thanked the Commission for all of their hard work on the four-and-a-
  half-year process. The Department received the approval letter from HCD on
  Friday which is posted on the City’s website. The Historic Preservation program is
  kicking off with its first Historic Preservation Commission meeting on Wednesday,
  September 25th at 6:00 P.M., after which the draft ordinance will be released for
  review, and community comments will be taken until December. Five (5) public
  meetings will be held by district through October into November. (7:11 P.M.)

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:13 P.M. to Monday,
